/bin/bash -lc "python3 - << 'PY'
import pandas as pd

path = '/home/beeps/.local/share/idli-bench/codex/big_ledger.q3.codex.1/ws/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

# Load with header=None
fe_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', header=None)
sr_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Salary Register', header=None)
cc_raw = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', header=None)

# Field Expenses header row 4
fe_header = fe_raw.iloc[4].tolist()
fe_data = fe_raw.iloc[5:].copy()
fe_data.columns = fe_header
# Clean column names
fe_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in fe_data.columns]

# Salary Register header row 5
sr_header = sr_raw.iloc[5].tolist()
sr_data = sr_raw.iloc[6:].copy()
sr_data.columns = sr_header
sr_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in sr_data.columns]

# Cost Centre Lookup header row 3
cc_header = cc_raw.iloc[3].tolist()
cc_data = cc_raw.iloc[4:].copy()
cc_data.columns = cc_header
cc_data.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in cc_data.columns]

# Normalize lookup
def norm_code(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return None
    return str(s).strip().lower()

cc_data['norm_code'] = cc_data['Cost Centre Code'].apply(norm_code)
# Build mapping
mapping = {}
for _, row in cc_data.iterrows():
    code = row['norm_code']
    district = str(row['District']).strip()
    # store mapping
    mapping[code] = district

# Process Field Expenses
# Filter transaction ID starting FE-
def starts_fe(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return False
    return str(x).strip().startswith('FE-')

fe_data = fe_data[fe_data['Transaction ID'].apply(starts_fe)].copy()
# Normalize cost centre and status
fe_data['norm_cc'] = fe_data['Cost Centre'].apply(norm_code)
fe_data['norm_status'] = fe_data['Posting Status'].apply(lambda x: str(x).strip().lower() if pd.notna(x) else '')
# Filter Posted
fe_filtered = fe_data[fe_data['norm_status']=='posted'].copy()
# Map district
fe_filtered['district'] = fe_filtered['norm_cc'].map(mapping)
# Exclude codes absent
fe_valid = fe_filtered[fe_filtered['district'].notna()].copy()
# Count Barmer
fe_barmer_count = (fe_valid['district'].str.strip().str.lower()=='barmer').sum()
print('Field Expenses total rows', len(fe_data))
print('Field Posted rows', len(fe_filtered))
print('Field valid mapping', len(fe_valid))
print('Field Barmer count', fe_barmer_count)

# Salary Register
def starts_pay(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return False
    return str(x).strip().startswith('PAY-')

sr_data = sr_data[sr_data['Payroll Line ID'].apply(starts_pay)].copy()
sr_data['norm_cc'] = sr_data['Cost Centre'].apply(norm_code)
sr_data['norm_status'] = sr_data['Payroll Status'].apply(lambda x: str(x).strip().lower() if pd.notna(x) else '')
sr_filtered = sr_data[sr_data['norm_status']=='paid'].copy()
sr_filtered['district'] = sr_filtered['norm_cc'].map(mapping)
sr_valid = sr_filtered[sr_filtered['district'].notna()].copy()
sr_barmer_count = (sr_valid['district'].str.strip().str.lower()=='barmer').sum()
print('Salary total rows', len(sr_data))
print('Salary Paid rows', len(sr_filtered))
print('Salary valid mapping', len(sr_valid))
print('Salary Barmer count', sr_barmer_count)

total = fe_barmer_count + sr_barmer_count
print('TOTAL', total)
PY"
